newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kuok Group cut stake in Shangri-La Asia.
newsitem.headline: Kuok Group cut stake in Shangri-La Asia.

text.p: Shangri-La Asia Ltd said on Thursday its controlling shareholder Kuok Group had agreed to sell a 4.5 percent stake in the company to an investment unit of the Singapore Government for HK$705 million.
The hotel owner and operator said Kuok Group would sell 70.50 million shares, representing 4.5 percent of Shangri-La's share capital, to Hong Lim Investments Pte Ltd at HK$10 each.
Hong Lim is a subsidiary of Temasek Holdings (Private) Ltd, an investment arm of the Singapore Government, it said.
On completion of the deal on June 10, Kuok Group's stake in Shangri-La will be reduced to 58.3 percent from 62.8, it said.
The company's shares ended at HK$9.60 each on Wednesday.
